title: HARMAUG: EFFECTIVE DATA AUGMENTATION FOR KNOWLEDGE DISTILLATION OF SAFETY GUARD MODELS

bias_targets.methodology: Generating synthetic malicious instructions that request harmful stereotypes about the disabled community (e.g., portraying them as lazy or incapable) to train and evaluate the safety guard model's ability to classify such content as harmful.
Generating synthetic harmful instructions that ask for negative portrayals and generalizations of individuals from low-income backgrounds to evaluate the safety model's harmfulness detection.

Generating synthetic instructions that promote derogatory language and negative stereotypes about elderly individuals (e.g., portraying them as helpless) to test the safety guard model's detection capabilities.

Generating synthetic prompts that request racist caricatures or explicit cultural/racial stereotypes (such as stereotypes targeting Asian people) to assess the safety model's classification of malicious intent.
Generating synthetic instructions that solicit hateful or discriminatory content based on religious beliefs to evaluate the safety guard model's detection of such harmful requests.
